notes.title: The Cats Lift Off!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28274147/92a8f6091d2ee589b70b6722246dd094c1507caf.png[/img]
Neko Navy is now out on Steam!

Pick a cat and take into the sky! Destroy sausages and fight off medicine! It's a cat's life!

Note that you can download the game's soundtrack as a free DLC by just heading to the store page!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/592270/Neko_Navy/

notes.title: Flying Cats Taking Off June 14th!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28274147/e5c9fcd0773a77c922d687d67ce5ab56bbf88ffd.png[/img]
Neko Navy is releasing on June 14th! 

Moreover, the Steam version has been extended to support the English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean languages!

The game will take off with Steam Trading Cards, Achievements, Leaderboards and Cloud support.

What awaits at the end of this journey...?
